description_en: Retrieves information about a specified Dataset Accelerator component
description_zh: 获取指定数据集加速组件的信息
name: DescribeComponent

parameters.help_en: The Dataset Accelerator component ID. To obtain the component ID, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467918.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速组件ID。如何获取组件ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467918.html
parameters.name: component_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to render and display the component template.
If the value is true, the response includes the rendered template content.
Only the following components are supported:
  dataset-accelerator
The maximum length of the returned component template content is 4096 bytes. Content that exceeds the maximum length is truncated
parameters.help_zh:
是否对组件模板进行渲染并展示。
如果值为true，则返回中包含模板渲染后的内容。
只支持指定组件列表：
  dataset-accelerator
返回的组件模板内容最大长度为4096 Byte，超过最大长度会对模板进行截断
parameters.name: render_template

parameters.help_en: The parameters used for rendering the component template
parameters.help_zh: 组件模板渲染时使用的参数
